**A Tannakian description of the local Kaletha gerbe**

*ALEXANDER BERTOLONI MELI AND PETER DILLERY*

26 pp, 19 sections.

**Abstract.** We construct, for a p-adic field F, an explicit semisimple Tannakian category RigIsocF whose category of fiber functors recovers Kaletha’s Galois gerbe EKal. We then classify and write down the simple objects in RigIsocF , all of which come from elliptic twisted Levi subgroups of GLn.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 1.1 Motivation and overview; 1.2 Preliminary notation; 1.3 Acknowledgments; 2 Construction of Tannakian Categories; 2.1 Products of gerbes; 2.2 Limits of gerbes; 2.3 Modules; 2.4 Descent; 2.5 Concrete Tannakian categories; 2.6 Transition maps; 2.7 The category RigIsocF; 3 The structure of RigIsocF; 3.1 The Newton map; 3.2 Comparison with isocrystals; 3.4 Reduction to Newton centralizers; 3.5 Classification of simple objects
